summary_en: Premium Water Holdings authorized repurchase of up to 140,000 shares (0.46% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 500 million yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 to September 30, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and enable flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Premium Water Holdings has authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act. The company may repurchase up to 140,000 shares of its common stock for a maximum aggregate consideration of 500 million yen. The repurchase will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 11, 2026 through September 30, 2027.

The acquisition represents 0.46% of outstanding shares (30,692,872 shares excluding treasury stock as of November 10, 2026). The company intends to use these purchases to enhance shareholder returns and pursue flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. No price ceiling per share is disclosed in this authorization notice.
